Commentary.Commentary: We are back. South Africa players take the field. Followed by Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie who walk out to open for Ireland. Keshav Maharaj to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then. Ireland need to chase down another target that surpasses the 200-run mark. They got close to achieve the same against India. Will they be able to get over the line successfully here? We shall find out soon. Do join us for the chase on the other side.

Reeza Hendricks is in for a chat. He starts by saying he definiately enjoyed his innings. Mentions he was well supported by Aiden. Says it was nice with the new ball but they had to adapt as the match progressed. Adds that they were looking 220 plus but the wicket was a touch slow and thinks 211 is enough. Ends by saying he is surely backing his bowlers to defend the total.

Ireland were good in patches but over all lacked a bit of discipline. They would have been looking to keep it tight and restrict South Africa to a reasonable target. After sending back Quinton de Kock and Rassie van der Dussen on timid score, they would have hoped to do much better.However, their bowlers could not maintain the pressure and let South Africa off the hook. Gareth Delaney was the pick of the bowlers getting the two set batters in consecutive deliveries. Other than that there was not much for the Irish fans to cheer about.

South Africa started a bit watchful and looked to analyse the wicket after electing to bat first. That did not last long as Reeza Hendricks, who has been in the form of his life, got going very soon after. South Africa lost two wickets in the Powerplay but once the partnership between Reeza Hendricks and Aiden Makaram started flourishing, runs started flowing far too freely. Reeza Hendricks reached his fourth consecutive half-century in T20Is and Aiden Makaram got his fifty in just 25 deliveries. They shared a 118-run partnership after which both departed on consecutive deliveries. Later, Tristan Stubbs and Dwaine Pretorius applied the finishing touches.

This has been quite a batting display from a South Africa and they have posted a commanding total of 211 on the board. The partnership between Reeza Hendricks and Aiden Markaram was the key as it set up a perfect platform for the hitters to take them over the 200 mark. Ireland have an uphill task ahead of them.
FOUR! A great end for the Proteas. It is full, wide outside off. Dwaine Pretorius reaches out, opens the face and glides it over backward point for four. SOUTH AFRICA END THEIR INNINGS AT 211/5.
WIDE! A slower bouncer on off. Dwaine Pretorius misses his attempt to put it away. The umpire calls it a wide due to height.
A length ball, on off. Dwaine Pretorius smashes it to wide long off. Barry McCarthy sprints to that side and keeps the ball in play with a dive to his left. They take two.
SIX! This goes all the way. Full length, on middle and leg. Dwaine Pretorius wrists it over the square leg fence for six.
FOUR! Mark Adair spills this one down leg. Dwaine Pretorius uses the pace really well and flicks it past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
This is quicker and short, outside off. This one flies off the deck. Dwaine Pretorius walks across and tries to pull it away but only connects it with this air.
Good length, wide of off. Heinrich Klaasen slaps it down the ground to long off for a single.
Shorter again, outside off. Heinrich Klaasen pulls it to deep square leg for one. He retains the strike for the final over.
Short ball, on middle and leg. Dwaine Pretorius swings hard across the line. It flies off the top edge but lands safely. They take one.

FOUR! EDGY! Back of a length, angled in around middle and off. Dwaine Pretorius stays back and tries to punch it away late. It takes the outside edge, goes past the keeper and into the boundary at third man.
Short ball, on off. Klaasen pulls it to long on for a single.
WIDE! Full, wide outside off, even outside the tramline. Klaasen leaves it alone. Wide called.

OUT! CAUGHT! An incredible catch by Lorcan Tucker. He makes amends for his sloopy work behind the sticks so far. This should boost his confidence also for Little, as he gets his first wicket of the innings after an expensive spell so far. It is short, on off. Tristan Stubbs stands tall and tries to pull it away. It goes towards fine leg off the top edge. Lorcan Tucker covers a lot of ground, keeps his eyes on the ball and in the end takes a solid catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Dwaine Pretorius has walked out to the middle.
WIDE! Full, wide of off, even outside the tramline. The umpire signals a wide.
Josh Little comes 'round the wicket and serves a short ball, angled into the body. Heinrich Klaasen hooks it along the ground to deep square leg for one.
Heinrich Klaasen drills this full delivery to long off for a single. 8 runs off the over.
A slower full-length delivery, outside off, at 109 kmph, Heinrich Klaasen tries to fetch it but gets undone by the pace this time.
A low full toss, wide outside off. Stubbs hits it down to long on for one.
Slower short ball, on off. Stubbs pulls it hard to square leg. The fielder there dives to his left and makes a sharp stop. They take two.
FOUR! It is cheeky but it pays off. A full length wide outside the tramline. Tristan Stubbs shuffles way across outside off, turns the face of the bat and helps it over slip cordon for a boundary.
It is full, wide outside off. Tristan Stubbs tries to reach out with a wild slash. It takes the bottom edge and goes to the keeper.
Barry McCarthy comes in for his last over.
Fraction short, on off. Stubbs whips it across the line to deep mid-wicket for a single. He moves to 17 runs. The same amount of runs were conceded in this over by Mark Adair.
FOUR! Tristan Stubbs is only dealing in boundaries now. His third on the trot. It is full, outside off. Tristan Stubbs makes room and slaps it over extra covers for four.

SIX! BOOM! This six from the moment he hit it. Tristan Stubbs moves to the leg side and Adair follows him with a full-length ball. Tristan Stubbs stays back and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
FOUR! Tristan Stubbs gets his first boundary. It is full and on off. Tristan Stubbs dances down the track and lifts it towards long off for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off, nips in a touch. Heinrich Klaasen pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A low full toss, on off. Stubbs hit to long on for one more.
Fuller, down leg. Stubbs nudges it to mid-wicket for one. He gets off the mark.
Tristan Stubbs makes his way out to the middle after two quick wickets.

OUT! CAUGHT! A classy innings by Reeza Hendricks comes to an end. He gets a warm reception as he walks off the filed. He surely missed out on his ton and would be very disappointed. Gareth Delany has turned the game on its head. It is a short ball, outside off. Reeza Hendricks stays back and tries to cut it away. It goes more off the outer half towards backward point. Paul Stirling dives in front of him to take a solid catch. Ireland are back in the game now. Gareth Delany on a Hat-Trick.
Commentary.Howout: c Paul Stirling b Gareth Delany

Commentary.Commentary: Heinrich Klaasen is the new man at the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! A much needed breakthrough for Ireland. They will be happy to see the back of Aiden Markram. Gareth Delany fires it short, on the bodyline. Aiden Markram comes down the track and short-arm jabs it it to deep mid-wicket. He does not get the desired distance on it. Harry Tector settles under it and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Gareth Delany

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! High and handsome! Floated and full, on off. Markram comes down the track and tonks it over long on for a maximum.
A single now as this pushed down to long on.
FOUR! A freebie for Reeza Hendricks. A full toss, on the pads, Reeza Hendricks flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Goes for the bouncer once again and bowls this slower in the air. Reeza Hendricks pulls the ball towards fine leg to take a single and keep strike.
This is another well-directed bouncer. Angles this into the batter and Reeza Hendricks looks to pull but gets beaten.

That is fifty for Aiden Markram! What an inning he has played here! Aiden Markram is down the wicket, Curtis Campher serves this on a length and follows him towards the leg side. Aiden Markram clips this towards deep square leg and gets a single. Gets to his half-century in just 25 deliveries! Also brings up the 100-run partnership between these two.
This is full and outside off, Reeza Hendricks pushes the ball towards the cover fielder and takes a single.
Bangs this in short and outside off, Reeza Hendricks looks to guide this down to third man and misses. A rare dot ball.
Curtis Campher attempts a yorker but instead ends up a full toss on the pads, Aiden Markram clips this towards fine leg for a single.
This is short and outside off, Aiden Markram has room to swing his arms but hits this straight to deep cover for a single. 22 runs off the over.

FOUR! Josh Little has been destroyed in this over by Aiden Markram! This is short and outside off, Aiden Markram pulls this towards the cover corner fence and it lands just before the boundary to give South Africa four more runs! Aiden Markram is just one hit away from his half-century now.
SIX! Aiden Markram is unleashing his real power here. It is short, on the body. Aiden Markram stays back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum. This pair is motoring along really well here.
FOUR! Aiden Markram races to 37 now. It is a touch fuller, around off. Aiden Markram hits it on the up and lofts it towards long on. One bounce and into the fence.

SIX! All the way! Aiden Markram does not even bother looking after hitting this one. It is full, on the pads. Aiden Markram uses his wrists and flicks it over the square leg fence for a maximum. This one might've even left the ground.
A short ball, around middle. Hendricks pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
Change. Josh Little (2-0-23-0) is back into the attack now. Switch of ends for him now.
This is full and Barry McCarthy follows the batter towards the leg side and he sees him shuffle down and make room. Aiden Markram flicks the ball towards deep mid-wicket and gets a couple of runs.
This is slow as well and going down leg from a shorter length. Reeza Hendricks pulls this towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Barry McCarthy goes short once again in line with the stumps. Takes the pace off the ball this time and Aiden Markram pulls this towards mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! What a shot! Uses the pace of the bowler for this one. Barry McCarthy pulls his length back and serves this outside off, Aiden Markram looks to make room and upper cuts the ball over the third man fence for a maximum!
Barry McCarthy bangs this one in short and towards the leg side, Reeza Hendricks mistimes his pull towards deep square leg for a single.
It is full, on off. Reeza Hendricks flicks it down to long on and comes back for the second run.
Change. Barry McCarthy is back into the attack.
A single now as this is worked down to long off.
Short ball, on the body. Markram pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.

SIX! BANG! Aiden Markram gets into the act now. It is tossed up, full and on off. Aiden Markram gets down the track and smokes it over the bowler's head for a biggie. He couldn't have hit it any cleaner.
Short one, outside off. Reeza Hendricks pushes it through covers for one.
FOUR! Gareth Delany drags his length back, around middle and leg. Reeza Hendricks swivels and pulls it flat through square leg. He disects the two fielders in the deep to find the boundary.
Touch short, on middle and leg. Reeza Hendricks gets it into the deck off the inner half.
This is on a good length and outside off, Aiden Markram looks to work this leg side and gets a leading edge just short of the point fielder.
This is on a length and angling into the pads, Reeza Hendricks flicks this towards deep square leg for a single.
This is a fraction full and outside off, Aiden Markram punches this down to long off for a single.
This is banged in short and angled into the batter. Aiden Markram sways out of the way. Good bouncer from Curtis Campher.

WIDE! Straying down leg once more and Reeza Hendricks happy to leave this one as well. Curtis Campher not getting these slower deliveries right. The keeper can not collect this as well and the fumble leads to a extra run.
This is on a good length and outside off. Nips back in sharply and Aiden Markram clips this towards square leg for a single.

FIVE WIDES! This is a poor delivery from Curtis Campher. Bowls this full and down leg side, takes some pace off the ball, and bounces just in front of the keeper as he lets it through for four runs towards fine leg.
Curtis Campher starts with a back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Aiden Markram punches the ball towards deep point for a couple of runs.

Drinks! Ireland did pick up two wickets inside the Powerplay, but they haven't been able to strike since then. They would be desperate to break this stand between Hendricks-Markram. This pair can surely take the game away from them. An enticing passage of play awaits.
Touch short, outside off. Reeza Hendricks cuts it hard to point. The fielder there dives to his right to make a sharp stop.

A huge appeal for lbw but the umpire is unmoved. It looks to be plumb and Andy Balbirnie decides to take the review for lbw. Coming to the delivery, it is tossed up, around middle and leg. Reeza Hendricks presses forward to defend it out but misses. He gets rapped on the pads. It is taken upstairs. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows that it is umpire's call on ball hitting the wickets. Reeza Hendricks gets a lifeline here. It was very close and the South African gets fortunate here.
FOUR! Top shot! It is short, on middle and leg. Reeza Hendricks is seeing the ball pretty well here. He pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for four.
On off, Markram goes back and chops it towards sweeper cover for one.
Flatter, on the pads, Hendricks nudges it to mid-wicket for one.
This is flighted, around leg stump. This one skidds through. Reeza Hendricks goes back to push it away but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
FIFTY FOR HENDRICKS! His fourth on the trot in T20Is. It is on a length, on the pads, Reeza Hendricks flicks it to fine leg and crosses for one.
FOUR! 49 up for Reeza Hendricks. It is short, outside off. Reeza Hendricks stays back and cuts it behind backward point for a boundary. He seems to be in incredible form.
It is full, angled into the pads. Markram tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Gareth Delany has been give the ball now. Ireland looking at various options to try and get a breakthrough.
BEATEN! Back of a length, outside off, shaping away a bit. Aiden Markram stands tall and tries to cut it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A single now as this is worked to mid-wicket.
A short ball, outside off. Markram stays back and cuts it to deep point for one.
Barry McCarthy (1-0-9-0) has been bought back into the attack.
This is pushed towards mid on for one. Markram retains the strike.
Fuller, outside off. Reeza Hendricks lofts it towards deep point and gets a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Reeza Hendricks is on a roll! Short ball, on middle and leg. Reeza Hendricks pummels it to the deep mid-wicket fence for four.
FOUR! Into the gap! It is tossed up, outside off. Reeza Hendricks lofts it over extra cover. There is no one present in the deep. There is man coming in from sweeper cover but the ball wins the race.
Floated, sliding down leg. Reeza Hendricks misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. A stifled appeal from the bowler. Going down leg without a doubt.
A single as this is pushed down to long on.
Back of a length, outside off. Reeza Hendricks stays back and cuts it hard to point but not in the gap.
George Dockrell has been brought into the attack.
Josh Little comes 'round the wicket. A length ball, angled in on off. Markram flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Hendricks tucks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Pulled away nicely! Short ball, sliding down leg. Reeza Hendricks swivels on the back foot and pulls it past short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Little now bends his back and serves it short, on off. This one flies off the deck. Reeza Hendricks thinks about poking it but decides against it.
FOUR! Too much width on offer. Josh Little dishes it full, wide outside off, angled across the right-hander. Reeza Hendricks reaches out and slashes it through point for a boundary.
Josh Little has been brought into the attack. He has been expensive conceding 13 runs in his first over.
Another single as this is worked down to long on. A wicket-taking over by Andy McBrine comes to an end.
Aiden Markram gets off the mark. Flatter and on off. Markram hits it to long on for a single.
Aiden Markram walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rassie van der Dussen has to walk back on a timid score. A huge, huge wicket for Ireland. It is tossed up, full and on off. Rassie van der Dussen tries to flick it away towards mid-wicket but is a tad early into his shot. It takes the outside edge and lobs towards short third man. Josh Little there takes a dolly. Ireland on the front foot here.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Little b Andy McBrine

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nicely played! It is short and on off. Rassie van der Dussen gets down on one knee and whips it to deep square leg for a cracking boundary.
On the pads, flicked to square leg for one.

Touch short, around off, spinning in. Reeza Hendricks stays back and punches it through covers. It bounces in front of the diving fielder and races away towards sweeper cover. Harry Tector gives it a chase and keeps it down to two.
Change. Andy McBrine (1-0-3-0) is back into the attack now.
Fraction short, on middle and leg. Reeza Hendricks drags his pull towards fine leg for a single.
WIDE! Barry McCarthy attempts a slower delivery but strays down leg side. The umpire indicates that this is wide.
This is a much better length and cramps the batter for room. Reeza Hendricks fends this towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! This has been smoked! Barry McCarthy bangs this one in short and outside off, Reeza Hendricks goes on the back foot and whips this over the infield towards the deep mid-wicket fence for four more runs.
Barry McCarthy goes really full and onto the pads, Reeza Hendricks clips this through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
This is on a good length and outside off, Reeza Hendricks comes across the line and fends it back towards the bowler.
Barry McCarthy bowls this short and outside off, Rassie van der Dussen whips this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
This one nips back in sharply. Mark Adair delivers this on a good length and outside off, Rassie van der Dussen clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
Mark Adair getting this on a good length and just outside off, Rassie van der Dussen fends this down the pitch.

FOUR! That is a really good shot! Mark Adair serves this on a length and outside off, Rassie van der Dussen strokes this on the up through the gap in the offside as the ball runs away to the deep cover fence to get him off the mark with a boundary!
Nice movement! A length ball, on middle, this one nips in off the deck. Rassie van der Dussen gets inside the line and blocks it awkwardly.
Full length, wide outside off. Reeza Hendricks pushes it to covers for a single.
Rassie van der Dussen is the next batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Incredible piece of fielding by Harry Tector. Mark Adair serves it full and on off. Quinton de Kock pushes it gently towards mid off and scampers across for a quick single. Harry Tector sprints towards the ball, gets low, collects the ball and scores a direct hit it at the non-striker's end with an underarm throw. The fielders are excited and the umpire takes it upstairs. It confirms that Quinton de Kock does not have his blade behind the popping crease. An early wicket for Ireland. That's what they were after.
Is this a run out? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The replays show that there is no bat behind the line and Ireland get their first wicket as the big screen shows OUT.
Change. Mark Adair is back into the attack.
This is served on a good length and outside off, Reeza Hendricks watchful, as he fends this towards point.
Back of a length and outside off, Quinton de Kock plays this late towards backward point for a quick single.
Short and wide outside off, Reeza Hendricks slashes this towards deep cover-point for a single.
Gets his line a fraction closer but still outside off on a good length. Reeza Hendricks goes for the short and gets beaten this time.

FOUR! This has been dismissed out of sight! Josh Little has started really poorly this over. This one is really wide outside off and served on a full length. Reeza Hendricks reaches out and gets his bat to it. Flies through the gap at cover-point for a boundary! South Africa getting a move on now!

SIX! South Africa get their first boundary and it is a maximum! Josh Little is really wide outside off, Reeza Hendricks has room to free his arms and he thumps this over the deep cover fence for a biggie! What a hit this is and Reeza Hendricks is on his way!
WIDE! Josh Little begins with a loose delivery served full and wide outside off, Reeza Hendricks leaves this alone and is called wide by the umpire.
Josh Little comes into the attack now.
This is short as well, and turning into the batter from outside off, Reeza Hendricks goes back in the crease and punches the ball towards long on for a single.
Short this time and wide outside off, Reeza Hendricks goes back in the crease and cuts this but straight to the backward point fielder.
Goes full and outside off, Reeza Hendricks fends this back to the bowler's right.
This one is full as well and angled into middle and leg, Quinton de Kock clips this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Goes 'round the wicket to the left-hander and fires this one full and in line with the stumps. Quinton de Kock fends this back towards the bowler.
Andy McBrine flights this full and outside off, Reeza Hendricks works this down to long on for a run.
Andy McBrine to share the new ball.
Mark Adair has been too leg side as he strays onto the pads once again from a fuller length. Quinton de Kock works this through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Goes a fraction full outside off, Reeza Hendricks plays this with soft hands towards cover-point and takes a quick single.
On a good length and just outside off, Reeza Hendricks fends this towards mid on.
Mark Adair goes full on the pads this time and Quinton de Kock flicks the ball towards deep square leg for a single.
Straying on leg once more and on a length, Quinton de Kock clips this towards deep backward square leg for a brace.
Gets it right this time! This is served on a good length and nipping away from the left-hander after pitching on middle. Quinton de Kock gets beaten all ends up.
WIDE! Mark Adair starts with a good length delivery but straying down leg, Quinton de Kock leaves this one alone and the umpire calls wide.

Right then, both the teams stride out to the middle of the ground and get lined-up for the national anthems. It will South Africa's first followed by Ireland. Done with all the pre-match proceedings. Ireland players are seen to be in a huddle before they break out to their respective positions. Followed by Reeza Hendricks and Quinton de Kock who walk out to open for South Africa. Mark Adair to start with the new ball. Here we go...

So, David Miller has been ruled out of the game with a lower back muscle spasm and it will be Keshav Maharaj to act as a stand-in skipper for the first match of this T20I series. Also, it is surprising to not see Rilee Rossouw in the starting XI after an impressive outing against England lately. Mostly, the Proteas are trying out some different combinations with the T20 World Cup just around the corner. They will also be without Kagiso Rabada due to an ankle injury.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Reeza Hendricks, Rassie van der Dussen, Aiden Markram, Heinrich Klaasen, Tristan Stubbs, Dwaine Pretorius, Wayne Parnell, Keshav Maharaj (C), Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie (C), Lorcan Tucker (WK), Harry Tector, Gareth Delany, George Dockrell, Curtis Campher, Mark Adair, Barry McCarthy, Andy McBrine, Josh Little.
TOSS - The coin is flipped into the air and it falls in favor of South Africa. They have elected to BAT first.

Ireland have put on some strong performances all through the summer without actually getting over the line. They have played New Zealand and India quite recently, putting up a good fight but kept stumbling as their inexperience would come to the forefront. They have a young side under the leadership of Andy Balbirnie and they have a lot of talent at their disposal. It is only a matter of time before they get a complete performance to upset one of the big guns of cricket. Will it be today? Stay tuned for the toss in a bit…
